description: This file defines the `SugarHttpClient` class, a basic HTTP client used to send POST requests via cURL, primarily for REST API calls within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem. It includes methods for making HTTP POST requests and for retrieving error states.

classes.name: SugarHttpClient
classes.description: A basic HTTP client class for performing POST requests via cURL, used throughout SuiteCRM for REST interactions.

methods.name: callRest
methods.description: Sends a POST request to a specified URL with given arguments using cURL, logs the process, and handles errors.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error code encountered during HTTP requests.
